quotes.text: // Do not optimise this for-loop. More tasks could be added.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current MigrationTasks uses an index loop over live _tasks.length because task actions may add more tasks. Each action is awaited; one subtask level is awaited and status/progress emitted. Replacing this with a captured map/parallel Promise.all could lose late tasks or change ordered migration behavior. The source comment explains why the loop is intentional; no migration run occurred.
title: Keep migration tasks sequential while allowing the queue to grow
